title: Show the cyclotron status strip and review-rate override in the Newsroom
description:
Above the References list, render the Cyclotron status widget (decision-flywheel-a161455d) from the cyclotron-status KnowledgeRawPayload snapshot: version, agreement, says-sure versus is-right, review rate and its reason, last change and its version. The card variant opens from the strip and offers the review-rate override (rate and expiry) for editors in the write groups; the override is stored as a request the next sweep applies and logs. Ordering: after the pipeline hook; needs the engine review-rate program (decision-flywheel-a81068b4) and package release.

Acceptance criteria:
- Strip renders from the snapshot with no engine access from the browser; stale snapshots say how old they are.
- Only editors in the write groups see the override; a non-editor sees the strip read-only.
- The override appears in the next snapshot with who set it and when it expires.,

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented on feature/PPY-049b6e-cyclotron-status (built on the repin, PR #172): the References tab shows CyclotronStatusView's strip above the list (from the KnowledgeRawPayload snapshot the sweep records; demo mode uses a fixture), a stale-snapshot note, and 'What the cyclotron is doing' with the card (classifierName 'Relevant to this publication') and, for editors who may curate, a manual review rate form (rate and days, or clear). The request is a KnowledgeRawPayload the browser writes (knowledge-raw-payload-cyclotron-review-rate-request-<id>, JSON in a raw_payload attachment); the sweep applies the newest request once with the editor as set_by, and the status shows the override. Specs: features/newsroom-cyclotron-status.feature 2/2 plus the relevance scenarios 4/4 (6/6 twice against next dev, demo mode), scripts/test-relevance-status-ui.ts (in test:ci:ts), sweep scenarios 8/8 including two for the request. Also filed PPY-2cd49c (atomic Assignment claims) and PPY-90ae22 (scope-training export may be missing negatives), with evidence. test_markus_export fails on develop in this environment too (botocore crt credential provider).

right_now_summary: The References tab now shows cyclotron status and lets editors set a temporary review rate.
